_meta.title: Genocides (Wikidata)
_meta.measures: Every Wikidata item that is an instance of genocide (Q41397) or a subclass, with countries, dates and deaths where recorded. Items Wikidata classes as genocide are included as Wikidata states them; the classification is Wikidata editors', not a court's. Many have no coordinates; those are placed at the centroid of their first country (precision 'country').
